item.text:
**ResStock excludes dormitories and assisted care facilities, but includes high-rise apartment buildings.**

| Building type | Included? |
|---|---|
| Dormitories | No |
| Assisted care facilities | No |
| High-rise apartment buildings | Yes |

ResStock follows the U.S. Energy Information Administration’s definition of a housing unit, which excludes congregate housing but includes high-rise multifamily housing—even when building codes classify it as commercial. [ResStock building-type documentation](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/resources/explanations/Building_Types.html)

For high-rises, ResStock models individual apartments and their allocated share of shared HVAC and water heating. Most common-area energy use, such as elevators, hallway lighting, and shared laundry, is excluded. [ResStock FAQ](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/docs/FAQ.html)
